name: After Dark Audio Story Narration
description: Audio-first workflow focusing on paranormal account collection, script layout, and voice optimization.

steps.name: Account Collection
steps.description: Gather paranormal stories, historical ghost records, or scary listener submissions.

steps.name: Script Writing
steps.description: Format narration script to build a high suspense atmosphere, marking out long pauses and cues.

steps.name: Sound Design Plan
steps.description: List sound effects and compile dark drone background tracks to blend under V.O.

steps.name: Narration Check
steps.description: Read draft out loud, adjust pacing pauses, check pronunciations, and optimize flow.

steps.name: SEO & Thumbnail
steps.description: Generate dark-themed titles, tags, and custom YouTube metadata packages.
